title: Sean McVay didn't have much to say after Sunday night's loss

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Sean McVay didn't have much to say after Sunday night's loss
sources.description: Anyone hoping to hear a detailed breakdown of why the Rams blew a 16-point halftime lead in Sunday night's loss to the Broncos was left disappointed by head coach Sean McVay's postgame press conference.
